project.name: SpaceX Autonomy — Mission-State & Operational Decision Logic
project.summary: Deterministic Python/Go simulation toolkit with bounded decisions, failure handling, quorum logic, and native verification.

claims.claim: Built a deterministic Python and Go autonomy simulation toolkit with explicit mode selection, bounded control, input validation, mission-thread quorum logic, and receipt-bound verification.
The system preserves conflicting simulated votes, fails closed on invalid conditions, and emits deterministic SHA-256 receipts rather than implying real vehicle authority.

project.summary: Public presentation layer compiled from Helix-governed, evidence-bound portfolio truth.

claims.claim: Built a hiring-system presentation layer whose public recruiter, resume, master, mesh, atlas, and machine surfaces are projections of Helix-governed evidence rather than independent claims.
The hiring system uses claim → observable behavior → implementation → executable verification → receipt → public promotion as its evidence path and fails closed on stale or unsafe projections.
